description: A blank panel you can make any width and any colour, with one hidden jack that makes it flicker

inputs.text: Flickers the panel from a cable; the module treats the signal as bipolar once it goes below 0V, and as 0-10V once it goes above 5.25V, subtracting 5V in that case

notes: the flicker jack is behind the #d medallion at the bottom, and is only there while both Show branding and Brand logo are on; Brand logo comes up off, so a new Null shows no jack
drag the left or right edge to change the width; the drag handle appears when the pointer is over an edge
a Copper or Copper-mini sets this panel's colour only from the right-hand side; the module tests its right-hand neighbour twice and never looks left
Copper sets panel color has to be on here and Share color as Extender on in the Copper; the colour is then kept in the patch, so the Copper can be taken out again
menu: Palette color — sets the panel colour from a list of named colours
Background — opens a colour picker for the panel colour, transparency included
Copper sets panel color — allows a Copper or Copper-mini beside this module to set the panel colour
Show branding — shows or hides the ring-and-slash mark and the #d medallion
Brand logo — shows the #d medallion when branding is on, which is also what puts the flicker jack on the panel
Glow in the dark — the panel keeps its own light when the Rack room brightness is turned down, with a halo scaled by the Rack light bloom setting
Bright in a dark room — the panel is not dimmed when the Rack room brightness is turned down

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
